instructions_to_main_agent: Build a comprehensive Furniture Manufacturing ERP & Analytics Dashboard (Mobilya Üretim ve Yönetim Paneli) in React.js with Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, Recharts, and Sonner toasts. Ensure all interactive and info elements have data-testid attributes. Support Product & Recipe Management, Material Stock & Supplier Management, Automated Cost Calculation & Selling Price Recommendation, and Sales/Expense/Order Tracking.

universal_guidelines: Never use pure black #000000; use tinted dark greys like #121212 and #1E1E1E
Ensure all buttons and form inputs have hover and active states with proper contrast
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) on container cards
